question.prompt: If February is a month that contains Friday the \(13\)th, what day of the week is February \(1?\)

solutions.explanation: Weekdays repeat every seven days, so February \(13-7=6\) was also a Friday. February \(1\) is five days before February \(6\). Counting backward from Friday gives Thursday, Wednesday, Tuesday, Monday, Sunday. Therefore February \(1\) was \(\boxed{\text{Sunday}}\), choice \(\text{A}\).
solutions.title: Go back one week, then five days
